messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, creating a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Sat Dec 31 – Sun Jan 1 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | Mon Feb 20 – Wed Feb 22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | Mon May 22 – Wed May 24 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Mon Sep 4 – Wed Sep 6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Mon Oct 9 – Wed Oct 11 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Monday | Mon Nov 11 – Wed Nov 13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 | Monday | Mon Dec 25 – Wed Dec 27 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Victoria Day) are observed only in certain provinces.  
> • The long‑weekend span includes the statutory holiday plus the adjacent weekend days.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app!
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a function connectBluetooth but that's irrelevant. There's no function to fetch holidays. We can respond with the list manually. Provide the dates. Let's list major public holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, long weekends typically include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (varies), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25). But long weekends are those that fall on Friday or Monday. For 2023:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1 2023 (Sunday) -> long weekend (Sat Dec 31 2022 - Sun Jan 1 2023)
- Family Day: Feb 20 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon Feb 20 - Wed Feb 22)
- Good Friday: Apr 7 2023 (Friday) -> long weekend (Fri Apr 7 - Sun Apr 9)
- Victoria Day: May 22 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon May 22 - Wed May 24)
- Canada Day: Jul 1 2023 (Saturday) -> long weekend (Sat Jul 1 - Mon Jul 3)
- Labour Day: Sep 4 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon Sep 4 - Wed Sep 6)
- Thanksgiving: Oct 9 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon Oct 9 - Wed Oct 11)
- Remembrance Day: Nov 11 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon Nov 11 - Wed Nov 13)
- Christmas: Dec 25 2023 (Monday) -> long weekend (Mon Dec 25 - Wed Dec 27)

Also maybe Boxing Day: Dec 26 2023 (Tuesday) not long weekend.

Also maybe other provincial holidays like St. Patrick's Day (Mar 17) not long weekend.

Thus provide list. Also mention that some holidays may vary by province. Provide a table.
